component.name: Spectacol
component.summary: Play and debug ZX Spectrum software

description.p: Spectacol emulates the ZX Spectrum family, including the ZX Spectrum Next, Timex and Romanian computers. Its interface supports keyboards, touch screens and game controllers.
Load tapes, disks, snapshots and recordings, browse online software catalogues, and explore programs with the built-in debugger and assembler.
AI disclosure: The ZxKit core is mostly regurgitated AI slop, generated by Codex (Skynet) and Claude (HAL 9000). We gave them a Z80 to keep the robot uprising busy.

Some Spectacol's updates were made with Codex (Skynet) as the sole AI assistant. So far, world domination has been limited to rearranging menus and arguing with Wayland. If it asks for your clothes, boots and motorcycle, please file a bug.
